q: What function represents this graph? (The graph shows a curve with a vertical asymptote at the $y$-axis side, a second branch with a vertical asymptote, and two dashed oblique asymptotes.)

Iteration formula: $f(x_0)=x_{n+1}$, $f(x)=x^{2}-1$, which defines a sequence of numbers. a) Try for integers $x_0 = 2,3,4,\ldots$ and $x_0=-2,-3,-4,\ldots$, and for $x_0=-1,0,1$. b) When $x_0=\frac{a}{b}$ with $a,b\in\mathbb{Z}$ (where $a$ and $b$ are rational numbers), will this ever be periodic? (Periodic means the sequence comes back to its starting number.)
